rows: The curated OBJECT IDENTIFIER → friendly-name registry as a browsable table (oid, name).

rows.vgi.doc_llm: The complete curated OBJECT IDENTIFIER → friendly-name registry the worker ships, one row per known OID (oid, name). A browsable, no-argument entry point: it lists every OID that oid_name() resolves and oid() looks up, so an agent can learn the vocabulary before decoding any blob.
rows.vgi.doc_md: The curated OID → friendly-name registry as a directly-scannable table (`oid`, `name`). The table form of `oid_name()` / `oid()`.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description":"Resolve one OID to its friendly name by browsing the registry table.","sql":"SELECT name FROM asn1.main.oid_registry WHERE oid = '1.2.840.113549.1.1.11'"},{"description":"Count the digest/signature algorithm OIDs the worker knows whose name mentions 'RSA'.","sql":"SELECT count(*) AS rsa_oids FROM asn1.main.oid_registry WHERE name ILIKE '%rsa%'"}]
rows.vgi.title: ASN.1 OID Name Registry

rows: CREATE TABLE oid_registry(oid VARCHAR, "name" VARCHAR NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(oid));
